sentences.text: Bonnie Lynne Hunt -LRB- born September 22 , 1961 -RRB- is an American stand-up comedian , actress , director , producer , writer and host .

She has appeared in films , such as Rain Man , Beethoven , Beethoven 's 2nd , Jumanji , Jerry Maguire , The Green Mile , Cheaper by the Dozen and Cheaper by the Dozen 2 .	Rain Man	Rain Man	Beethoven	Beethoven (film)	Jumanji	Jumanji	Jerry Maguire	Jerry Maguire	The Green Mile	The Green Mile (film)	Cheaper by the Dozen	Cheaper by the Dozen (2003 film)	Cheaper by the Dozen 2	Cheaper by the Dozen 2

Hunt has done voice work in A Bug 's Life , Monsters , Inc. , Cars , Toy Story 3 , Cars 2 , Monsters University , and Zootopia .	Cars	Cars (film)	Toy Story 3	Toy Story 3	Cars 2	Cars 2	Monsters University	Monsters University	Zootopia	Zootopia

She starred in Grand and Davis Rules , as well as creating , producing , writing , and starring in The Building , Bonnie , and Life with Bonnie .	Grand	Grand (TV series)	Davis Rules	Davis Rules	Life with Bonnie	Life with Bonnie
From 2008 to 2010 , she hosted The Bonnie Hunt Show .	The Bonnie Hunt Show	The Bonnie Hunt Show
